extracted.name: Green Bean Tater Tot Casserole
extracted.description: This hearty green bean Tater Tot casserole with ground beef and mushroom soup is sure to become a family favorite.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (14.5 ounce) can French style green beans
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Brown ground beef in a large skillet over high heat until browned and crumbly; drain fat. Stir in condensed soup, milk, garlic salt, and green beans. Pour mixture into a medium-sized casserole dish and top with a layer of tater tots.
Bake in preheated oven until tater tots are browned and crispy, about 30 minutes.
